statement: A snapshot document's header is read from its body: the stored bytes are the whole document, and the only way to make a SnapshotDocument is SnapshotDocuments, which reads schema, revision and publishedAt from them (read) or from the document it encodes (of). No main code of any module calls the constructor, so no store, candidate or test kit can state a revision its bytes contradict, and the revision an instance reports installed is the revision of the content it enforces. A shadow candidate's record holds its window, its base revision and its document only; a record that states the header beside the document is refused as an unreadable candidate.
guards: document:PolicyDocumentAtTest#at changes the revision and the time it is published, and nothing else
document:PolicyDocumentAtTest#copy passes on every field it is not told to change
document:ShadowCodecTest#a candidate record that states its header beside its document is refused
runtime:CandidateRecordShapeTest#a candidate record in the shape of 8_0_0-alpha_4 is not compared, and the request is answered as without it
